"Tumhara best teacher—pichhli mistake."
"Tum kya karte ho itna loud bolta—kehna sunai nahi deta."
"Vision ko chase kar, paise ko nahi."
Tumhara karm hi tumhari manzil tay karta hai.
"Abhi—next best time yahi."
Jab mushkil ho, phir bhi chalte raho.
Jeevan mein aapko kayi haar ka samna karna padega, lekin khud ko kabhi haarne mat dena.
Success ke baad failure ka intezar mat karo.
Itna high aim karo jitna tum sochte ho usse bhi.
